name: first-run-returning-user
description: IXT-SUITES first-run re-rung: proves BOTH first-run persistence contracts end-to-end across a real browser reload, not just at unit level. (1) Boot decision (src/ui/bootDecision.ts): a clean profile boots the onboarding carousel; clicking the top-nav 'Skip' button (untested by the other first-run-*.json scenarios, which only exercise 'Take the guided tour' / 'Enter sandbox') closes it without picking a starting point and persists hdb_onboarded='1' to real localStorage — a real page reload (not a store reset) must NOT reopen the carousel. (2) Location-prompt dismissal: locationPromptDismissed is persisted via the design AUTOSAVE (serialize() in state/schema.ts + PERSISTENT_WATCH_KEYS in state/storage/autosave.ts; the pagehide flush covers a reload inside the 500ms debounce window), so after the reload the 'Where are you?' modal must NOT reappear either. The regression this guards is a returning user re-seeing any first-run overlay.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-no-first-run-overlay-after-buffer
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.onboardingOpen !== false) throw new Error('onboarding carousel reopened after a buffer wait — boot decision fired late or re-fired'); if (document.querySelector('.modal-overlay')) throw new Error('a modal overlay (location prompt?) surfaced for a returning user'); })()
